title: Dragon Tiger
betGuide: Bet on Dragon, Tiger, or Tie — higher rank wins (A=lowest, K=highest)

tutorial.betButtons: Pick Dragon, Tiger, or Tie and place your bet
tutorial.results: The result and Big Road history are shown here
tutorial.betControls: Bet on Dragon, Tiger, or Tie. Dragon and Tiger pay 1:1, while a Tie pays 8:1.
tutorial.cards: One card is dealt to Dragon and Tiger each; the higher card wins. Equal ranks are a Tie.
tutorial.bigRoad: The Big Road records past results so you can track the Dragon/Tiger trend.
